name: Lychee
description: Lychee is a free photo-management tool, which runs on your server or web-space. Installing is a matter of seconds. Upload, manage and share photos like from a native application. Lychee comes with everything you need and all your photos are stored securely.
short_desc: Lychee is a free photo-management tool, which runs on your server or web-space
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: DB_CONNECTION
form_fields.hint: DB type, from sqlite, mysql, pqsql.

form_fields.label: DB_HOST
form_fields.hint: DB server hostname. For mysql and pgsql only.

form_fields.label: DB_PORT
form_fields.hint: DB server port. For mysql and pgsql only.

form_fields.label: DB_USERNAME
form_fields.hint: DB user. For mysql and pgsql only.

form_fields.label: DB_PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: DB password. For mysql and pgsql only.

form_fields.label: DB_DATABASE
form_fields.hint: Path to DB file for sqlite. DB name for mysql and pgsql.

form_fields.label: APP_URL
form_fields.hint: The URL you will use to access Lychee including protocol, and port where appropriate.

form_fields.label: TRUSTED_PROXIES
form_fields.hint: Set to the IP or netmask covering your reverse proxy, if running behind one. Set to to trust all IPs (do not use if exposed to the internet).
